job.title: Business System Analyst, QA Engineer, and Sr. Full Stack

tailoring.headline: Senior Software Engineer (Hybris Developer) | Full Stack & Business Systems | SAP Commerce Cloud
tailoring.summary: Backend and full stack e-commerce developer with 5+ years of professional experience building enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Combines deep Java, Spring Boot, REST web services, and storefront customization with techno-functional business analysis and quality assurance testing. Proven track record delivering complex system integrations across ERP, PIM, and MDM ecosystems, performance tuning database queries, and executing CI/CD deployments in agile environments. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Business System Analyst, QA Engineer, and Sr. Full Stack
cover_en.hook: With more than five years of enterprise e-commerce experience delivering complex SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) implementations for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I offer a blend of full stack engineering, quality assurance rigor, and techno-functional business analysis. I am excited to bring my end-to-end expertise across commerce architectures and business workflows to your engineering teams.

bullets.label: Hybris & Full Stack Engineering
bullets.text: Designed and implemented both backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (2105/2211) using Java, Spring, and JavaScript, delivering custom OCC REST APIs for headless commerce and PWA frontends.

bullets.label: Business Systems Analysis
bullets.text: Collaborated directly with business stakeholders and product owners to analyse requirements, translate needs into functional specifications and user stories, and map end-to-end processes for SAP ERP and PIM integrations.

bullets.label: QA & Quality Engineering
bullets.text: Built automated unit and integration test suites with JUnit, performed detailed code reviews, and supported user acceptance testing (UAT) to safeguard system stability and data consistency across releases.

bullets.label: Platform Operations & Delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, refactored high-latency database queries, and resolved production integration bottlenecks across complex enterprise environments.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit (no sponsorship required), I am currently serving my notice period with a final working day of 15 December 2026 and am available to start from 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical and analytical background aligns with your team's objectives.

tailoring.why_company: Your multidisciplinary engineering initiatives demand professionals who can bridge the gap between technical execution and business logic. Having delivered complex SAP Commerce Cloud integrations and full-stack solutions for global organizations, I am eager to contribute robust software engineering, methodical QA testing, and sharp systems analysis to drive high-impact platform implementations across your product lines.
tailoring.motivation_short: Certified SAP Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of full stack, integration, and techno-functional systems analysis experience across enterprise environments, eager to drive reliable software delivery and high platform quality for your teams.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I noticed your opening bridging Hybris development, full stack engineering, and business systems analysis. With 5+ years across SAP Commerce Cloud (2105/2211), Java/Spring, and requirement analysis at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I would welcome the chance to connect.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Business System Analyst, QA Engineer, and Sr. Full Stack – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the open engineering and systems analysis position. With over five years of professional experience developing enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud solutions, executing full-stack integrations, conducting business systems analysis, and driving software quality, I am keen to support your team's delivery goals. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and am available to start on 16 December 2026. Thank you for your time and consideration.
